name: Mexican Pie
text: A quick taco-seasoned beef and refried-bean pie topped with a sour cream–green sauce layer and melted cheddar.
instructions: Brown 1 lb hamburger and drain.
Add taco seasoning and refried beans.
Put the mixture in the bottom of 2 small pie pans.
Mix sour cream and green taco sauce; spread on top.
Sprinkle with cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 20–30 minutes, until the cheese is melted.
